Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIXT.1.1

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Number of characters after this field up to and including the delimiter immediately preceding the CheckSum.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: The message type.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: CompID of the party sending the message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: CompID of the party the message is sent to.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: The sequence number of the message.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Whether the message was previously transmitted under the same MsgSeqNum (34). Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Whether the message was previously transmitted under a different MsgSeqNum (34). Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time the message was transmitted. Not required for incoming messages sent by the clients (even if sent by a client, no validation will be done). Required for outgoing messages sent by the server.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: The ID of the party which the message is on behalf of; will only be used in client-initiated messages.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: The value specified in the OnBehalfOfCompID (115) field will be stamped; will only be used in server-initiated messages. Won't be received for RFQ-related messages.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Time the message was originally transmitted. If the original time is not available, this should be the same value as SendingTime (52). Required if PossDupFlag (43) is Possible Duplicate (Y).

Field.Name: ApplVerID
Field.Description: Version of FIX used in the message. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to establish a FIX session.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: The method of encryption.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Indicates the heartbeat interval in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the client and server should reset sequence numbers. Absence of this field is interpreted as Do Not Reset Sequence Numbers (N).

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: The password assigned to the CompID. Required if the message is generated by the client.

Field.Name: NewPassword
Field.Description: The new password for the CompID.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session or the request to change the password. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Default version of FIX messages used in this session.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to terminate a FIX session.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: The field will contain the next expected sequence number if the server terminated the connection after receiving a sequence number that was less than what was expected. In other cases, the field will contain the reason for the logout.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to exercise the communication line during periods of inactivity and verify that the interfaces at each end are available.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required if the heartbeat is a response to a Test Request. The value in this field should echo the TestReqID (112) received in the Test Request.

Message.Name: Test Request
Message.Description: Allows the client or server to request a response from the other party if inactivity is detected.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier for the request.

Message.Name: Resend Request
Message.Description: Allows for the recovery of messages lost during a malfunction of the communications layers.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of first message in range.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of last message in range.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Used to reject a message that does not comply with FIXT.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: If a message is rejected due to an issue with a particular field, its tag number will be indicated.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType (35) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the SessionRejectReason (373).

Message.Name: Sequence Reset
Message.Description: Allows the client or server to increase the expected incoming sequence number of the other party.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the next message to be transmitted.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: The mode in which the message is being used. Absence of this field is interpreted as Sequence Reset (N).

Message.Name: Trade Capture Report
Message.Description: Reports a trade or trade bust from the server, and allows the client to report a late cancellation of an on-book trade (PC trade) or cancel an on-book trade on the day. Merged from sections 7.3.1 (client-initiated), 7.3.2 (server-initiated) and 7.3.8 (cancellation of on-book trades), which share MsgType AE.

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: Identifier of the partition.

Field.Name: ApplSeqNum
Field.Description: Partition's sequence number for trade.

Field.Name: ApplLastSeqNum
Field.Description: ApplSeqNum of last trade generated for client. Required if ApplResendFlag (1352) is "N" and TradeRequestID (568) is not present. Tag 1350 will not be populated on the first TCR sent to the client (since zero is not a valid value).

Field.Name: ApplResendFlag
Field.Description: Whether the message is sent in response to an Application Request. Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: TradeRequestID
Field.Description: Identifier of the Trade Capture Report the message is sent in response to.

Field.Name: LastRptRequested
Field.Description: Indicates the last message sent in response to a Trade Capture Report Request.

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Identifier of the message.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Identifier of the trade. If an on-book trade is being cancelled, then the TradeID assigned to the particular trade by the system needs to be referred in this field. Trade ID will be a 36 base encoded value in ASCII format. The base 10 format is available in tag 27020 DecimalTVTIC.

Field.Name: TradeLinkID
Field.Description: Identifier of the transaction in which the trade was executed.

Field.Name: FirmTradeID
Field.Description: Identifier assigned to a PC trade by the counterparties. Used for TrdSubType (829) = 24 (PC – Previous Day Contra) report submission. Maximum of 50 characters.

Field.Name: TradeReportRefID
Field.Description: Reference to trade being cancelled. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade Cancel (H) or Trade Correct (G).

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Handling instructions to client. The system will validate the TradeHandlingInstr sent for an on-book trade cancellation request.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Type of trade report. Value '6' should be used for on-book trade cancellation and '0' should be used for PC trade submission.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Type of execution being reported. This field is mandatory for any on-book trade published by the system and any trade or cancellation request confirmed by the server for PC trades. For PC trade submission, value 'F' will be stamped.

Field.Name: ClearingType
Field.Description: Defines whether the particular instrument is cleared or not. Required for messages published by the system.

Field.Name: NovatedIndicator
Field.Description: Defines whether the trade needs to be sent to clearing system. Required for messages published by the system.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Type of transaction being reported.

Field.Name: MatchStatus
Field.Description: Status of the trade.

Field.Name: OrigTradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Model under which PC trade was confirmed. Required if TrdType (828) is PC Trade (54).

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade. Value '54' should be used for PC report submission.

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: Conditionally required if TradeType denotes a PC trade. The system will not validate the TrdSubType on a PC cancellation.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time trade or cancellation occurred. If a PC trade is reported, this is the date and time it was executed on the participant's system. This field should be mapped to the Transact Time of the internal TCR.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Traded quantity. Required for PC trade report submission. It is not possible to submit trades with zero or negative value for LastQty (32). This field should not contain more than 14 characters, excluding the decimal point, and should not use more than eight decimal places when used.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Traded price. Required for PC trade report submission. It is not possible to submit trades with zero or negative value for LastPx (31). This field should not contain more than 14 characters, excluding the decimal point and should not use more than eight decimal places when used.

Field.Name: SettlDate
Field.Description: Date on which the trade will settle. Stamped for on-book trades and PC trade submission. The format should be YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Point in matching process trade was matched.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique Instrument ID assigned to the instrument in the Millennium Exchange.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: MarketID
Field.Description: The market posting the trade (MIC Code).

Field.Name: OrigTradeDate
Field.Description: Specifies the original date and time of the trade. For trade cancellations, the original trade date and time is stamped.

Field.Name: ContraOrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book of the contra order of an RFQ execution (i.e., when TrdType = 99 (RFQ Trades)). Absence of this field is interpreted as RFQ Trade book for an RFQ trade. This field is not applicable to any other trade type.

Field.Name: DecimalTVTIC
Field.Description: The base 10 format of TradeID (TVTIC) (1003). This is the same value as provided by the GTP Trade ID and Native Trade Match ID (TVTIC).

Field.Name: ProductComplex
Field.Description: Segment of the instrument.

Message.Name: Trade Capture Report Request
Message.Description: Allows the client to query/request for a set of Trade Capture Reports from the server.

Field.Name: TradeRequestID
Field.Description: Identifier for the trade request.

Field.Name: TradeRequestType
Field.Description: If none of the criteria below are specified, this will return all trades for the particular participant.

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: Conditionally required if TradeType denotes an PC trade. The system will not validate the TrdSubType on an PC cancellation.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique Instrument ID assigned to the instrument in the Millennium Exchange.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the executed order.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Point in matching process trade was matched.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Identifier of the executed order as specified by the entering firm.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Identifier of the executed order as specified by matching system.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Required if SecurityID (48) is specified.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client reference for the trade.

Message.Name: Application Message Request
Message.Description: Allows the client to request retransmission of missed trades or the latest ApplSeqNum of each ApplID.

Field.Name: ApplReqID
Field.Description: Client specified unique identifier of the request.

Field.Name: ApplReqType
Field.Description: Type of request.

Message.Name: Application Message Request Ack
Message.Description: Indicates whether a request to retransmit trades or for the latest ApplSeqNum is successful or not.

Field.Name: ApplResponseID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the acknowledgement.

Field.Name: ApplReqID
Field.Description: Identifier of the request being acknowledged.

Field.Name: ApplReqType
Field.Description: Type of request being acknowledged.

Message.Name: Trade Capture Report Ack
Message.Description: Acknowledges the receipt of a Trade Capture Report message from the client.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Server-assigned identifier of the trade.

Field.Name: FirmTradeID
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report. Required only for the messages generated by the server to respond to client-generated messages with regard to PC trades.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report. This field will not be populated if the trade report gets rejected when a value is not specified in the trade report submitted by the client.

Field.Name: ApplSeqNum
Field.Description: Partition's sequence number for trade.

Field.Name: ApplLastSeqNum
Field.Description: ApplSeqNum of last trade generated for client. Required if ApplResendFlag (1352) is "N" and TradeRequestID (568) is not present.

Field.Name: TradeReportRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for rejection. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. Required if TrdRptStatus (939) is Rejected (1).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report. This field will not be populated if the trade report gets rejected when a value is not specified in the trade report submitted by the client.

Field.Name: TrdRptStatus
Field.Description: Specifies whether the Trade Capture Report was accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report.

Field.Name: MatchStatus
Field.Description: Status of the pre-negotiated trade.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique Instrument ID assigned to the instrument in the Millennium Exchange.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report. Will not be populated for TCR Acks generated for cancel request.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report. Will not be populated for TCR Acks generated for cancel request.

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Value submitted with the trade report.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: If acknowledging a PC trade sent with an empty TransactTime or invalid value, the value returned will be the time the message was generated by the server. Otherwise, the value submitted in the original trade report.

Field.Name: ApplResendFlag
Field.Description: Whether the message is sent in response to an Application Message Request. Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N). Will not be used in messages sent by clients for submitting PC trades.

Message.Name: Trade Capture Report Request Ack
Message.Description: Acknowledges the receipt of a Trade Capture Report Request message from the client.

Field.Name: TradeRequestID
Field.Description: Identifier of the request being acknowledged.

Field.Name: TradeRequestType
Field.Description: Value specified in the request.

Field.Name: TradeRequestStatus
Field.Description: Whether the request is accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: TradeRequestResult
Field.Description: Reason the request is rejected.

Field.Name: TotNumTradeReports
Field.Description: Number of Trade Capture Reports that will be sent in response to the request. Required if TradeRequestStatus (750) is Accepted (0).

Message.Name: Business Message Reject
Message.Description: Indicates that an application message sent by the client could not be processed.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Client-specified identifier (e.g., Firm Trade ID) of the rejected message if it is available. TradeCaptureReport uses FirmTradeID (1041), TradeCaptureReportRequest uses TradeRequestID (568) and ApplicationMessageRequest uses ApplReqID (1346).

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType (35) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: If a message is rejected due to an issue with a particular field its tag number will be indicated.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the BusinessRejectReason (380).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the executed order.

Field.Name: SideExecID
Field.Description: Identifier of the execution received by the order. Required only for messages sent by the server if TrdType (828) is Regular Trade (0) (i.e., not required for messages sent by clients for submitting PC trades).

Field.Name: TradingSessionSubID
Field.Description: Defines trading phase during which the particular trade has taken place. All trades that take place during the closing price crossing session should have this field set to 'z'.

Field.Name: OrderCategory
Field.Description: Type of interest behind trade. Tag 1115 for PC trades can be populated in the server-generated TCR based on an on/off switch.

Field.Name: SideLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Whether the order added or removed liquidity.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Identifier of the executed order as specified by the matching system. This will be a 62 base encoded value in ASCII format.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Identifier of the executed order as specified by the entering firm.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the firm that placed the order. For PC trades, the field is required for the side block that contains Executing Firm (1) Party Role (452). It should be omitted from the side block that contains Counterparty Firm (17) Party Role (452).

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client Reference specified at order entry and PC entry. A maximum of 10 characters. The valid range of ASCII characters (decimal) to preserve data integrity is 0 and 32-126 except 35 # (hash), 47 / (forward slash), 59 ; (semi colon) and 92 \ (back slash).

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Clearing account type. For PC trades, value will be the one submitted in the trade report for the block that contains Executing Firm (1) Party Role (452). For on-book trades, the field will be populated with the value submitted in the order.

Field.Name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via an algorithm. This field is only applicable to on-book trades.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not. This field is only applicable to on-book trades.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Identifier of the party. If a trade is internalised, the Counterparty Firm (17) will be populated with the user's own Firm ID. If an on-book trade is cleared, the Counterparty Firm (17) will be populated with the CCP and the Clearing Organization (24) with the Clearing Member. Other than the enumerated values, this could contain a short code identifier (i.e., 4 – 4294967295) provided by the user in case of the on-book trade.

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Value 'P' will only be applicable to on-book trades.

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Role of the specified PartyID (448). Trade Capture Report sent for PC trades will always have PartyRole (452) = 7 populated. In all messages published by the server Executing Firm (1), Counterparty Firm (17) and Trader Group (76) will be populated.

Field.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Field.Description: Provides a further qualification for the value specified in the PartyRole (452). This field is only applicable to on-book trades.

Field.Name: SecurityAltID
Field.Description: Identification number of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityAltIDSource
Field.Description: Type of instrument identification used. Required if SecurityAltID (455) is specified. When an ISIN is specified, all trades related to that ISIN will be disseminated (irrespective of the fact that whether the same ISIN had been used in multiple instruments).

Field.Name: OrderAttributeType
Field.Description: Provides information about the order. States if the order has been submitted as a part of liquidity provision activity (i.e., as a part of the market making strategy).

Field.Name: OrderAttributeValue
Field.Description: Will be populated if OrderAttributeType (2594) is specified.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationType
Field.Description: Specifies the type of regulatory trade publication.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReason
Field.Description: Additional reason for trade publication type specified in TrdRegPublicationType (2669). Populated when Execution Type is F or H. Populated when TrdRegPublicationType (2669) = 0 (pre-trade waiver).

Field.Name: RefApplID
Field.Description: Identifier of the matching partition.

Field.Name: ApplBegSeqNum
Field.Description: Application sequence number of first message in range to be resent. Required if ApplReqType (1347) is Retransmission of Application Messages (0).

Field.Name: ApplEndSeqNum
Field.Description: Application sequence number of last message in range to be resent. Required if ApplReqType (1347) is Retransmission of Application Messages (0).

Field.Name: RefApplLastSeqNum
Field.Description: ApplSeqNum of the last trade generated for the client. Required if ApplReqType (1347) is Request for Last ApplLastSeqNum (2) and ApplResponseError (1354) is not specified.

Field.Name: ApplResponseError
Field.Description: Reason request is rejected.
